name: skraft
description: skraft SDLC pipeline — agents, skills and instructions for outside-in TDD, Clean Architecture and the RESEARCH→DESIGN→DISTILL→DELIVER engineering pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: Deterministic agentic SDLC pipeline with adversarial review lenses and checks computed by its engine.
interface.longDescription: skraft turns a coding assistant into a disciplined software production line. Each engineering phase (RESEARCH → DESIGN → DISTILL → DELIVER) is driven by a specialized agent and reviewed by isolated read-only lenses. A host-neutral engine decides every step: it starts an agent only when its inputs exist, checks its outputs and its write scope after each step, runs the gates from skraft-config.json, computes the review verdict and replays each red TDD commit, all recorded in a hash-chained, signed journal.
